items.docs: Fetch a [transcript of an asset](https://docs.mux.com/guides/add-autogenerated-captions-and-use-transcripts#retrieve-a-transcript). This is only possible for assets with a text track generated using the [VOD generated captions feature](https://docs.mux.com/guides/add-autogenerated-captions-and-use-transcripts).
